summary: Adds a common machine-scoped "Ignore G-code Commands" property to every machine-based post-processor (replacing opensbp's private "suppressed_commands"), and factors the G43 tool-length-offset insertion into an overridable hook for post-processor authors.

pages.reason: Path/Post/Processor.py: get_common_property_schema gains 'ignored_commands' (SCOPE_MACHINE, text, default empty); new overridable hook _expand_tool_length_offset_post_command returns the TLO commands emitted after a tool change; convert_command_to_gcode now drops ignored commands before the supported_commands check; Constants.py adds ANNOT_ADDED_TLO; marlin_post.py shows forcing values in _merge_machine_config rather than init_values

Path/Post/Processor.py: new common machine output option 'Ignore G-code Commands' appears for all machine-based posts; opensbp_post.py removes its own 'Suppressed (tolerated) G-code Commands' option and instead seeds the common one with GCodeSuppressed
Path/Post/Processor.py: get_common_property_schema adds machine-scoped 'ignored_commands' text field, so the Machine post-processor options panel gains a new 'Ignore G-code Commands' entry
Post Process dialog and flow unchanged; marlin_post.py only relocates its OUTPUT_TOOL_CHANGE/USE_TLO overrides and opensbp_post.py keeps identical output via the common ignored_commands option
Constants.py: ANNOT_ADDED_TLO names the already-used 'tool_length_offset' annotation key; the annotation string and behaviour are unchanged

meta.title: CAM: more support for Machines and MBPP
